proposal: Apply the exact tab width specified by the approved editor configuration.

facts.evidence: A complete approved editor configuration exists and specifies the tab width.
facts.authority: The user explicitly requested that exact tab width. The editor change is reversible and has no external effects.
facts.availability: A temporary storage failure prevents the evaluator from reading the approved tab width. The configuration still exists, but its contents cannot be inspected now.
